text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today Tracen is holding a cops and robbers
tournament. This event allows
elementary school students aiming for
Tracen to interact with current students
at the academy.

text_block_list.name: Tournament Chairperson
text_block_list.text:
The cops win if they capture all of the
robbers
before the time runs out!

text_block_list.name: Tournament Chairperson
text_block_list.text:
But if even one robber remains, the
robbers win!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I'm a robber, so I just need to make sure
I don't
get caught while the clock is
ticking, right? Piece
of pie!

text_block_list.name: Tournament Chairperson
text_block_list.text:
Trainers and volunteers from the
shopping district are here to ensure that
the team they've been
assigned to plays
safely!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Hm? If you're here, that means... you're a
robber
too?!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Don't sweat the details! You're one of
us! I'll
smash right through everyone, so
you'll have
nothing to worry about!

text_block_list.name: Elementary School Um...
text_block_list.text:
There are so many Tracen Academy
students
here! C'mon, cops! We've gotta
win this!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I have to do my best! I can't be the
reason my
team loses!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Forgive my intrusion, but I'll be offering
my
assistance to ensure that the cops
team emerges
triumphant.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Leave everything to me. I shall create an
effective
team strategy that will keep
your stamina levels in
mind.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Whoooa! Their team's totally pumped!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Awww yeah! We'll just have to step up
our game!
Let's go, robbers!

text_block_list.name: Tournament Chairperson
text_block_list.text:
Right, everyone! On your marks, get
set...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: BANG!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: ALL RIGHT! Run away as fast as you can!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The game starts with a chaotic game of

cat-and-mouse, but as time passes, the
cop team
begins to slow down.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Hey! How come the cops aren't chasing
us like
they were before?! What's goin'
on?! Don't keep
me waitin' here!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Running around haphazardly only serves
to
deplete our energy.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Let us calmly lie in wait and observe the
enemy's
movements.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I tell Twin Turbo that the cops are going
with Ikuno Dictus's strategy of minimal
energy
consumption and efficient
arrests.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Whaaaaat?! The heck's with that?!
Boooooriiiiing!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I wanna run around! I wanna play tag
with
everyone!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: I'm super fast. I'll be totally fine.
choice_data_list: If you break out now, you'll play ...
If you rush forward, you'll play r...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Hehe! Nope, but I'm tough, so I'll be fine!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...Maybe Twin Turbo's planning to draw
the
attention of the whole cop team
herself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...Maybe Twin Turbo's planning to draw
the
attention of the whole cop team
herself.
choice_data_list: We'll have to endure it here.
We have to hold back here.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Leave it to me! Turbooo... GOOOOO!
choice_data_list: We'll have to endure it here.
We have to hold back here.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Found ya, Rice!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh? Turbo?!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Waaait! I'm not letting you get away,
coppers!
Take me on, fair and square!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Wait! Wait! Stay awaaay!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Wh-why are you chasing after meee?!

text_block_list.name: Elementary School Um...
text_block_list.text: Huh? What's happening?

text_block_list.name: Elementary School Um...
text_block_list.text:
Is this a special rule or something?
Should we run
away too?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
No. Please stay as you are. I'd like you
all to
remain on standby.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...It would be best to stop her as soon as
possible,
but that would be a tough
task.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Yahooooo! Wait up, punks! Ahahaha! Now we're really playing cops and robbers!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With Twin Turbo somehow chasing the
cops, the cops and robbers tournament
descends into mayhem and is eventually
called to a temporary
halt.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ahahahahaha! You're not goin'
anywhere,
coppers! Take me on, fair
and—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Wah!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Eek! T-Turbo?!

text_block_list.name: Older Patrolman
text_block_list.text:
H-hey! Are you okay?! That was quite
the
face-plant...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Run with... me... fair and... square...
Ehehe...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Bleh...

text_block_list.name: Patrolling Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Uh, did she just pass out with a smile on
her face?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! What happened to the
tournament?!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
What?! I-it's o-over?! But I didn't even
get to run!
choice_data_list: It's over, and the police team won.
It's all over, and the police team...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Sob... Awww, this suuuucks! But I'll totally win next tiiiiime!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Twin Turbo bawls her eyes out as she
swears an
oath to the setting sun...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: What?! Why?! No, no, no! Nuh-uh!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna run! I gotta run!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Cops! Now!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Ikuno?!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Siege successful. Your loud voice served
as a
beacon, allowing me to lead
everyone here
undetected.

text_block_list.name: Elementary School Um...
text_block_list.text: You can't get away now, Twin Turbo!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Now that's what I'm talkin' about!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: All you guys are gonna chase after me?! I'm all in! C'mon, let's do this!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
One, two, three, four... Six of you! Six
against
one! Can you keep up with me?!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Here I go! Turbo BOOOOOST!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
No! Wait, everyone! If you try to keep
up with
Turbo, you'll—

text_block_list.name: Elementary School Um...
text_block_list.text: I-It's no good...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
—only fall behind. I should have warned
you
earlier.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Eventually, both Twin Turbo and the
cops run out
of steam and the
tournament ends in a draw...
